# U70: Back agrees: the back link names where it goes and goes there; the browser’s Forward returns; after saving an edit the link and the browser’s Back both go to Goals; a goal opened in a new tab goes up the tree; no back link on a place’s first page

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `NAV-BACK`
- **Budget:** at most 9 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** every point but `logged` ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Rhea, at `{addr}` in the demo.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U70

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Rhea (`rhea`).
- _Note:_ A new tab on a goal that feeds another: up the tree; on one that feeds nothing: Goals; on a person: People.
- Repeated, as the code loops, 5 rows:
  - _Row:_ “/goals/lead-mq”, “Back to Merge-to-deploy time (median)”
  - _Row:_ “/goals/ns-lead”, “Back to Goals”
  - _Row:_ “/people/rhea”, “Back to People”
  - _Row:_ “/help/goals”, “Back to Help”
  - _Row:_ “/reviews/weekly”, “Back to Reviews”
  - Go to `{addr}` in the demo.
  - **Check:** The backlink in the main (`main .backlink`) shows.
- For each of `['/', '/goals?scope=all', '/settings', '/reviews', '/activity']`:
  - Go to `{addr}` in the demo.
  - **Check:** The h1 in the main, or the goals sr title in the main (`main h1, main .goals-sr-title`) shows.
- **Check:** (`entry`) met when `!wrong.length`, where `const wrong = []`. Else it says: {wrong.join('; ')}.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “new tabs”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ Goals → a goal → Change → Save: the link says Goals, and the browser's Back goes there too.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all` in the demo.
- **Step.** Open “Home” from the menu (the sidebar on a computer; the tab bar, or its More, on a phone).
- **Step.** Open “Goals” from the menu (the sidebar on a computer; the tab bar, or its More, on a phone).
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals”.
- **Check:** The a in the main (`main a[href*="/goals/ns-lead"]`) shows.
- **Step.** Press the a in the main (`main a[href*="/goals/ns-lead"]`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/ns-lead”.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `/^Back to (Goals|your goals)$/.test(await says())`, where `const back = p.locator('main .backlink').first()`; `const says = async () => ((await back.getAttribute('aria-label', { timeout: 5000 }).catch(() => '')) || '').trim()`. Else it says: a goal opened from Goals says “{says()}”.
- **Step.** Press the goal’s “…” menu.
- **Step.** Press the “Change this goal” link in the “More about this goal” group.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/edit”.
- Press the “Save changes” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/ns-lead”.
- **Check:** The goal’s summary bar shows.
- Press the browser’s Back.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals”.
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `/^Back to (Goals|your goals)$/.test(after) && new URL(p.url()).pathname === '/demo/goals'`, where `const back = p.locator('main .backlink').first()`; `const says = async () => ((await back.getAttribute('aria-label', { timeout: 5000 }).catch(() => '')) || '').trim()`; `const after = await says()`. Else it says: after saving, the link said “{after}” and the browser’s Back went to {p.url()}.
- _Note:_ The browser's Forward returns to the goal; the link goes back the same way.
- Press the browser’s Forward.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/ns-lead”.
- **Check:** (`progress`) the address matches “/goals/ns-lead” (else: Forward went to {p.url()}).
- **Step.** Press the backlink in the main (`main .backlink`).
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals”.
- Press the browser’s Forward.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/ns-lead”.
- **Check:** (`parity`) the address matches “/goals/ns-lead” (else: after the back link, Forward went to {p.url()}).
- _Note:_ Settings scrolls to its foot on a computer: the section links never pull the page back up, and the last is lit.
- If on a computer:
  - Go to `/settings` in the demo.
  - **Check:** The section links (`.section-links`) shows.
  - **Check:** (`progress`) met when `at.y >= at.max - 2 && at.lit === 'Leave'`, where `const at = await p.evaluate(() => ({ y: Math.round(window.scrollY), max: document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight, lit: document.querySelector('.section-links [aria-current="true"]')?.textContent?.trim() ?? '' }))`. Else it says: Settings scrolled to {at.y} of {at.max}, with “{at.lit}” lit.
- _Note:_ A goal opened from a saved view names the view (rule 4.2), as the Views menu does.
- Go to `/goals?scope=all&status=off` in the demo.
- **Check:** The Goals count line shows.
- **Step.** Choose “Save this view…” in the Views menu (the View sheet on a phone).
- Type “Off track, all” into the “Name” field in the “Save this view” dialog.
- Press the “Save view” button in the “Save this view” dialog.
- **Check:** The “Save this view” dialog goes away.
- _Note:_ A goal of the view's, not New goal (a form, which has no back link).
- **Step.** Press the visible=true (`visible=true`) in the a in the main (`main a[href*="/goals/"]:not([href*="/goals/new"]):not([href$="/edit"])`) not showing “”.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/goals/…”.
- _Note:_ Page not found offers Find in the page (navigation spec 2.6): a name finds that person, as a link.
- Go to `/no-such-page` in the demo.
- **Check:** “Page not found” is shown.
- Type “rhea” into the find input in the not found (`.not-found .find-input`).
- **Check:** The “Rhea Kapoor” option in the not found (`.not-found`) shows.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `fromView === 'Back to Off track, all' && found`, where `const back = p.locator('main .backlink').first()`; `const says = async () => ((await back.getAttribute('aria-label', { timeout: 5000 }).catch(() => '')) || '').trim()`; `const fromView = await says()`; `const found = await p.locator('.not-found').getByRole('option', { name: /Rhea Kapoor/ }).first().waitFor({ timeout: 5000 }).then(() => true, () => false)`. Else it says: a goal opened from a saved view says “{fromView}”; Page not found's Find {found ? 'found' : 'did not find'} Rhea.
- **Check:** (`one-action`) scored as met here.
- Close this browser.
